'''Min Sakul''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] who served in the [[Resistance]], 30 [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. During the Resistance's [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]], She was stationed at the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Min Sakul was portrayed by [[Leanne Best]] in the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] and was identified in the movie credits.<ref name="Episode VII" />
